args.body: Use the renewed lease and reconcile TASK-179524656100 and prior receipts with committed files before using any of the two official FETCHes. TASK-179524621001 found one historical release per process in the saved tender directory. Prioritize 105838-2026 (Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation) if no other process already has a verified second revision. Use any remaining retrieval on the official process history. If it confirms an open submission window and provides comparable revisions, execute the comparison and a no-change control, then produce the bilingual bidder checklist and stage it for exact-digest independent review. If the allowance is exhausted and a second comparable revision or live status is still missing, commit and read back the precise bounded result and close with a lesson. Reopen on an official revision pair and confirmed open window.

description: The three saved Find a Tender records each contain one historical release, so they cannot establish a current amendment or support a bidder-facing brief on their own. The existing trial can still test whether an official process history supplies a comparable revision and confirms that submissions are open. Independently, the SQLite release can be identified before its November 22 cutoff. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand inconclusive. Treasury shows no verified available funds or revenue.
